verified_mechanisms: capability tokens use structurally framed canonical JSON rather than delimiter-ambiguous signing bodies
signed time fields normalize to integer microseconds and fixed vectors match across Python and Node
subcap issuance requires a verified parent token
child capability sets must be strict or equal subsets of parent authority and cannot add capabilities
child validity cannot begin earlier or end later than parent validity
child request identity is distinct and child provenance binds the exact parent fingerprint and delegation depth
delegation verification fails for the wrong parent or tampered child content
deterministic delegation receipts bind parent/child identities, removed capabilities, time attenuation, and depth
boundaries: HMAC authority is a repository-local shared-secret issuer, not an externally rooted Cloudflare identity
no durable distributed replay state is implemented
not a production Workers authorization service
